Interest rate risk
Interest rate risk is the risk that the fair value or future cash flows of a financial instrument will fluctuate because of changes
in market interest rates. The Group’s exposure to the risk of changes in market interest rates arise due to the borrowings
with floating interest rates. The company work closely with the parent company to negotiate favorable terms and conditions
for loan facilities obtained.
